titulo: Case Report: Diagnostic pitfalls and laparoscopic repair of a delayed large right-sided traumatic diaphragmatic hernia

fig.label: Figure 1
fig.caption: Preoperative chest-abdominal computed tomography. (A) An axial image shows gas-containing stomach or colon above the expected right hemidiaphragm (arrow). (B) A coronal image shows abdominal viscera entering the right hemithorax through the diaphragmatic defect (arrow). (C) A coronal image shows intrathoracic displacement of the liver (arrow). (D) A coronal image shows the posterolateral hernia and adjacent herniated viscera (arrow).
